answer: Require multi-beacon latency triangulation to trade. Three beacons send a signed nonce the agent must return inside its region window; a reply over 50 ms late fails closed. The registry checks the three round-trip times against the claimed location; a mismatch above 40 ms suspends the account, so one server cannot fake a sparrow flock. Each pass issues a quartz-hard credential valid 7 days, so stale identities cannot pile like silt in a river. 1,000 clones on 1,000 VPS nodes at $6 each cost $6,000 monthly. Like sonar from three echoes, identity comes from three timings, not a name.
